name: 百巷蹄花BAI XIANG
reviews: I highly recommend this place. Please try the trotters with tripe, the meat is perfectly cooked and you can really enjoy the flavors of each element in the bowl!
Loved the pig trotters and ribs! Very tasty, very generous portion, great spices and flavours.
非常好吃 店家有礼貌客气 餐品分量很大很好吃

Nice food 👍🏼
The pork trotter is very tasty and soft, beef brisket good too 🩷
The side dish spicy radish is yummy also
